questions.prompt: Device Manager shows a yellow warning icon. What is the best first step?
options: A. Record the device name, status, and error code
B. Open a random driver website
C. Remove every driver
D. Format the computer
questions.answer: A. Record the device name, status, and error code
questions.explanation:
A. Record the device name, status, and error code

Identify the device and evidence before choosing a safe solution.

questions.prompt: Where is it safest to get a driver?
options: A. Windows Update or the manufacturer’s official support page
B. A pop-up advertisement
C. An unknown file-sharing site
D. A page for any computer model
questions.answer: A. Windows Update or the manufacturer’s official support page
questions.explanation:
A. Windows Update or the manufacturer’s official support page

Official sources reduce the risk of an incompatible or malicious driver.

questions.prompt: If the problem began after a driver update, what can you check?
options: A. Whether rollback is available and a recovery plan exists
B. How to delete every user file
C. How to change the BIOS password
D. How to install a random driver
questions.answer: A. Whether rollback is available and a recovery plan exists
questions.explanation:
A. Whether rollback is available and a recovery plan exists

Rolling back can resolve an update-related issue and should be planned safely.

questions.prompt: What should you do after changing a driver?
options: A. Test the device in its normal task and record the result
B. Close the ticket immediately
C. Delete the error message
D. Avoid telling the user
questions.answer: A. Test the device in its normal task and record the result
questions.explanation:
A. Test the device in its normal task and record the result

Testing confirms the fix; notes allow another technician to continue if needed.

questions.prompt: Why are unknown driver-updater apps risky?
options: A. They may install an incorrect or malicious program
B. They increase screen brightness
C. They always provide official drivers
D. They only improve internet speed
questions.answer: A. They may install an incorrect or malicious program
questions.explanation:
A. They may install an incorrect or malicious program

Unofficial tools may install incorrect, outdated, or harmful drivers.
